objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, etc.) that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level (1-4) indicating strategic to operational scope.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation used in the document name (e.g. RL for guideline).

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client 4-digit number per document type.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Descriptive title of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current version number of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the current released version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus the validity period.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable time period for validity check cycle (default 3 years).

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable retention period after invalidation (default 10 years).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document content.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Areas of validity or relevant companies for the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents, master data, IT applications, processes, organizational units, or risks.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Referenced IT applications linked to the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or organizational areas to which the document applies.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specification of which clients can see the document in a multi-client system.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document attached to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and is released together with the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A supplementary document attachment not subject to the release cycle, published directly via property switches without formal approval.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A formal proposal to amend an existing released document, created by any author-rights holder, tracked and managed within the document cockpit.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request triggered 30 days before a document's validity expiration, requiring workflow-supported processing.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a released document that has no additional validity, initiating the override (out-of-force) workflow.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated/archived document, restricted to the Business Admin group.

objs.name: author
objs.description: A person assigned the author role on a document, responsible for creating and signing the document in the first workflow step.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: A person assigned additional write permissions on a document who can also initiate the release workflow but does not sign in the creator step.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: A person assigned to check the content of a document for technical and/or formal correctness during the review workflow step.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: A person responsible for approving a document for distribution to readers during the release workflow step.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: A person who translates released content into another language; cannot create new objects independently.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A defined group of users used to assign read or change authorizations and distribution membership for documents.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Type of user group (e.g. Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive, Business Admin).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and persons maintained per document that controls email notifications and acknowledgement requests upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by email or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process instance that guides a document or request through defined approval, review, or acknowledgement steps.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow (e.g. release, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement, translation release).

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A signature provided by a workflow participant to confirm completion of a workflow step, documented per released version.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: Person who provided the signature.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the signature was applied.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Workflow step in which the signature was provided (creator, review, release).

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new document objects, supporting TAG technology for auto-printing metadata.

objs.name: report
objs.description: An evaluation or search report available in the system providing filtered results based on selection parameters and criteria.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Type of report (e.g. Status Report, Search for Documents, Acknowledgement Status).

attributes.name: role_scope
attributes.description: Target role for which the report is intended (Reader or Author).

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is attached in the system with selection of document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type_selected
attributes.description: The document type chosen during creation.

attributes.name: template_selected
attributes.description: The template chosen during creation, if any.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of the document are maintained or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated Office editing client.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: The document is automatically converted to PDF format after saving and displayed on the web.

evts.name: initiate_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step release workflow (Creator-Review-Release) is started by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step (Creator).

evts.name: complete_review_step
evts.description: A reviewer completes the review task, either positively or with rejection.

attributes.name: review_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the review: approved or rejected.

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Technical or formal review.

evts.name: complete_release_step
evts.description: A releaser completes the release task, either positively or with rejection, finalizing the document approval.

attributes.name: release_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the release: approved or rejected.

evts.name: reject_in_workflow
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, causing cancellation for all subsequent participants.

attributes.name: rejection_step
attributes.description: The workflow step in which the rejection occurred.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created due to content changes, attribute changes, attachment changes, or scheduled change proposals.

attributes.name: version_trigger
attributes.description: Reason for the new version (content change, attribute change, attachment change, change proposal).

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A new controlled attachment is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived with the release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_information
evts.description: Additional information is added to a document without affecting the main document version or release cycle.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: Additional information is deleted directly from a document without affecting the main document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for an existing released document by a user with author rights.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, triggering creation of a new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of an assigned change proposal, marking it as completed.

evts.name: generate_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the document's valid-until date.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: The validity extension request is processed through a workflow, resulting in either extension of validity or initiation of revision/override.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Result: validity extended, revision initiated, or override requested.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The document's Valid Until date is updated by the default period, confirming continued validity of the current version.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A request to invalidate a document is created by a user with write access.

evts.name: process_override
evts.description: The override request is processed through a workflow (by releaser or through creator-reviewer-releaser steps).

attributes.name: override_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the override process: confirmed or not.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document is declared out of force, its status is set accordingly, all rights except archive group are revoked, and the archive duration begins.

evts.name: physical_deletion
evts.description: After the archive period expires, the document and its attachments are physically deleted from the system.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A request for reactivation is created by a member of the Business Admin group for an invalidated document.

evts.name: process_reactivation
evts.description: The reactivation workflow is processed, resulting in a new version of the document with restored metadata and authorizations.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to user groups or persons for a document via property editing.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are notified by email upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are requested to actively confirm acknowledgement upon document release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A person confirms acknowledgement of a document via a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language by a translator.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated version of a document is checked and released through a workflow analogous to the original release process.

o2o.description: An attachment belongs to and is controlled by a main document.
Additional information is supplementary to a main document.
A change proposal belongs to and is displayed within a specific document.
A validity extension request is linked to the document whose validity is to be checked.
An override request is linked to the document to be invalidated.
A reactivation request references the archived document to be reactivated.
A document template is associated with a document type and can be used when creating documents.
An author is assigned to a document with read and write permissions.
A co-author is assigned additional write permissions on a document.
A reviewer is assigned to check a document during the review step.
A releaser is assigned to approve a document during the release step.
A translator is assigned to translate released document content.
A distribution list is maintained per document to control notifications and acknowledgements.
User groups are assigned to a distribution list for email or acknowledgement distribution.
Documents can reference other documents through the references attribute.
